ground_truth_rules.statement: A finalist entry naming exactly one person, on an official page stating the finalists pitch or take the stage, names the presenter. Entries naming several people without a presenter designation are presenter_unknown.

Finalist status in a founder competition satisfies newer-founder fit unless primary evidence shows the venture is established (e.g., a completed institutional Series A), in which case the case is established_founder.
A replay opportunity's reference_date is the date of the dated public announcement naming that edition.

description: Frozen v2 known-item benchmark for founder/organizer lead discovery (frozen 2026-11-14). Live-split opportunities use reference_date = benchmark_date (2026-11-14; in-window events 2026-11-21 to 2027-05-14). Replay-split opportunities use their own historical reference date (the dated public announcement, rule R3). checked_date records when evidence was reviewed. Ground-truth rules R1-R3 were approved by the user on 2026-11-14. Do not edit in place; corrections or additions require a new version.
